about_the_game:
Tome of Horrors Instant Encounters: Killer Frogs (5E)

Did your players finish your planned adventure an hour early? Do you need a quick transition scenario to bring the characters up a level before moving on? Tome of Horrors 2020 Instant Encounters: Killer Frogs is a micro-adventure perfect for those need-it-quick situations that always seem to appear.

The module includes:

  • Monster illustrations

  • Stats for the monster featured in the scenario

  • Maps for the scenario

Always roll a 20 on your Charisma (Gamemaster) saving throws!

Forgotten Fane  of the Frog God is is an adventure module for use in the Fantasy Grounds Virtual Tabletop set in the Half-Pickle Marsh, but can take place any time the characters are moving through a swamp or some kind of marshy terrain.

It is designed for 3-5 Tier 1  characters and is compatible with the world's most popular roleplaying game! No specific mixture of characters is essential to success with the adventure.
